info.title: Home Helper
info.description:
Shared household data for the Personal Home Helper phone app: money, shopping,
kitchen, chores, health logs and planning, all scoped to a household.

**Auth:** `POST /login` returns a Sanctum token; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Errors** always look like `{"message", "code", "errors"?, "request_id"}`; branch on `code`.

**Lists** take `page`, `per_page` (1–100, default 25), `sort` (`column` or `-column`),
`updated_since`, and `from`/`to` on dated modules.

**Rate limits:** 120 requests/min per user, login 6/min per account, sync 60/min, invites 20/hour.

Full guide: docs/api.md in the repository.

post.summary:
Saves the token for this user and this login. A token is one phone: if the
phone was registered before (by someone else who logged out, or another
login), it moves to whoever registers it now

delete.summary: Turns pushes off for this phone. Logging out does this too

get.summary: The households the caller belongs to, with their role in each

post.summary: Start a new household; the caller becomes its owner

Email someone a signed link to join the household. Inviting the same
address again sends a fresh link

Join the household from the signed link. The signature (checked by the
`signed` middleware) proves the link is ours, unchanged and not expired
